home.title: Programme records
home.intro: The complete organizational record: schools, classes, subjects taught, sessions held, course outlines, learners and reading material. Every record links to the others.

schools.title: Schools
schools.intro: {count} government schools across Leh and Kargil districts. Click any row to see its classes, teachers and sessions.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.intro: {count, plural, one {# teacher} other {# teachers}} across the partner schools. Tap a teacher to see their sessions and pairing.

mentors.title: Mentors
mentors.intro: Master mentors carrying 5 mentees each through quarterly progress checks.
mentors.exportTitle: Download all mentors as CSV — admin only, audited

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.intro: Curricular subjects across Grades 1–10. Each subject links to its course outlines, sessions and reading material.

outlines.title: Course outlines
outlines.intro: Term-level units per subject × grade. Each outline holds the learning outcomes, weekly lessons and the sessions delivered against it.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.intro: Every classroom session held — planned, in progress and complete. Each session links to its school, class, subject, teacher and course outline.

students.title: Learners
students.intro: Per-class learner records. Sample shown below; full database is restricted.
students.exportTitle: Bulk export learner PII as CSV — super admin only, audited
students.piiWarning: Learner records contain PII (name, age, guardian). Access is restricted to school staff and programme leads. Bulk export is audited and requires Super Admin approval.
